name: dev.workers.mnpi.airport-facts/airport-facts
title: Airport facts: codes, runways, frequencies
description: Airport by IATA/ICAO code, airports serving a town, nearest airports. Runways, frequencies, links.

tools.name: lookup_airport
tools.description: Facts about one airport from its IATA code (e.g. AKL, LHR, JFK), ICAO code (e.g. NZAA, EGLL) or OurAirports ident: full name, city, region, country, coordinates, elevation, type, whether it has scheduled airline service, runways (length, surface, lighting), radio frequencies, and links to the official website and Wikipedia. 9,900+ open airports worldwide. No live flight status.

code.description: IATA (3 letters), ICAO (4 characters) or OurAirports ident.

tools.name: find_airports
tools.description: Which airports serve a city or town, or what is the code of an airport by name? Returns matching airports (scheduled-service and larger first) with IATA/ICAO codes, city, region, country and coordinates. For a town (34,000 towns over 15k people) with no scheduled-service airport of its own, also returns the nearest airports that have scheduled flights, with distances. Use "City, Country" or the country argument to disambiguate (e.g. "Cambridge, NZ" vs "Cambridge, GB").

query.description: City, town or airport name, e.g. "Auckland", "Cambridge, New Zealand", "Heathrow".

country.description: Optional. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or English country name.

tools.name: nearest_airports
tools.description: The nearest airports to a latitude/longitude, with straight-line distance in km. By default only airports with scheduled airline service (an IATA code or medium/large size, not heliports); set scheduled_only to false to include all open airports in the dataset.

scheduled_only.description: Only airports with scheduled service (default true).
